fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-08-26 at approximately 12:40, it was reported that members of a chit group near Senthil Garden Main Street in Salem reported that the organiser stopped payouts, with the complainant owed about Rs. 3,50,000. Amudha Kannan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000066. Praveen Natarajan (9000000041) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint refers to Dinesh Prakash, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000068. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100081 as the destination of the transfer. The complainant alleged that Mathan Balan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000084. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, associate, receiving account, main street, afternoon, mobile number, witness
